annotations.title: Hand a reader's decision to the provider

description: Once the reader has agreed to go to a provider (consent: true), returns what to hand over: the provider's own address as ChainChoice's catalog records it (never a referral or affiliate link; ChainChoice earns nothing from it), the product's published rank and ChainChoice Score, the reader's country and monthly volume, the ranked list's page with that setup, whether the provider serves that country, and a receipt signed with ChainChoice's published key (check it with verify_receipt) recording exactly what was handed over. A provider that does not serve the reader's country is not handed off: handedOff is false with the reason. It does not open anything, log the reader or change any ranking.

category.description: A category id from list_categories, e.g. "exchange" or "hardware_wallet" (a ranked id), or one of its notRanked ids, which every tool answers with status "not_ranked".

consent.description: true only once the reader has agreed to be sent to this provider.

country.description: The reader's country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. "DE" (optional).

product.description: A product id from get_ranking or a search answer.

query.description: The reader's words, if the hand-off follows a search (optional, kept in the receipt).

name: hand_off
title: Hand a reader's decision to the provider
